text: Figure 11.24: Scenario: Recover from Critical Supervision Failure in Execution Management The figure 11.24 shows a scenario for Report Supervision Failure that handles recovery from a critical supervision failure in Execution Management . Such failures are considered as critical failures because Execution Management is required to recover from supervision failures. Thus, a supervision failure in Execution Management results in Platform Health Management calling the method FireWatchdogReaction() to perform a restart of the Machine.
